Its action is an extension of Plebanski gravity and recovers gravity, Yang-Mills, and Higgs sectors after symmetry breaking.

L05 defines a cyclic trilinear triality form and also permits the division-algebra product to be recovered from the triality form.

L05's explicit external citation attached to the twistor-incidence statement points to Woit 2021; target semantics remain opaque during Track L construction.
Exceptional unification is an application layer of the 2026 algebraic scaffold rather than the only permitted mathematical starting point.
The current source family contains genuine revision/reframing relations and must not be collapsed into a single timeless Lisi model.

items.body: For sp(3), L05 gives an explicit quaternionic 3x3 realization and canonical inner triality automorphism cycling vector/spinor generators and three su(2) factors; root-space rotations alone do not determine generator phases.

For f4, L05 treats compact and noncompact/split real forms with signature-sensitive Clifford metrics and generalized reflections; some real automorphisms contain explicit i factors whose reality is defined relative to an appropriate anti-linear real-structure operator.

L05 derives canonical so(8)/so(4,4) triality matrices from octonion/split-octonion multiplication tables, with allowed Cartan-signature patterns and block-Hadamard structure, while allowing noncanonical sign variants.

L05 gives multiple f4 decompositions emphasizing sp(3)-type and su(3)-type invariant subalgebras and labels root spaces suggestively as particle roles; the labels are presentation/model-building assignments, not part of the Lie-bracket definition.

Two division/split-composition algebras can be tensor-combined to construct compound Clifford representations whose associated triality Lie algebras combine into the exceptional magic square, with real form determined by the chosen metrics/signatures.

The magic-square Lie algebra decomposition is Tri(D')+Tri(D)+D'_v⊗D_v+D'_m⊗D_m+D'_p⊗D_p with brackets inherited from the constituent triality structures; each member has a canonical triality automorphism built from the constituent automorphisms.

L05 explicitly states that root-system/triality-matrix descriptions omit phases/signs of maps between root vectors, so explicit generator/division-algebra automorphisms carry stronger information than root-coordinate rotations alone.
An order-three triality automorphism decomposes each relevant Lie algebra into g_-1+g_0+g_+1 with bracket grading modulo three, conjugate ±1 eigenspaces, and a real invariant subalgebra g_0.

L05 defines Vinberg Theta-algebra data from g_0 acting on a selected positive eigenspace and distinguishes complex eigenspace decompositions from real gradings, which need not coincide for every real form.

For noncompact e8(8) and e8(-24), L05 gives triality-related five-gradings/two-gradings distinct in signature from the triality-invariant decomposition and identifies an extended graviGUT substructure inside e8(-24).

Within the e8 noncompact gradings, L05 distinguishes a 64-real Standard-Model fermion sector from mirror fermions and describes triality as rotations mixing physical/mirror real-imaginary planes rather than simple eigenvalue multiplication.
L05 constructs e6 from C⊗O triality data, with explicit brackets/real-form dependence, canonical triality, so(10)+u(1)+16+16 decomposition, and Standard-Model/GUT charge combinations.

L05 constructs e7 from H⊗O triality data and distinguishes two model-building readings: a real one-generation model with both chiralities or a complex/triality three-generation interpretation that cannot simultaneously house all chiral/antiparticle partners in the same real form.

L05 constructs e8 from O⊗O triality data with explicit bracket classes, real-form signatures, and canonical triality automorphisms; particle labels on roots are source model assignments layered over the algebra.

L05 states that direct three-linearly-independent-generation e8 assignments have Euclidean/signature and natural-two-grading drawbacks, so they are not presented as a complete Lorentzian physical model.

L05 gives a continuous pseudo-similarity Wick rotation inside e8 that rotates Clifford vectors, bivectors, spinors, and selected Cartan generators between Lorentzian and Euclidean presentations; root coordinates and spinor root vectors transform accordingly.

L05 uses triality eigenspaces after Wick rotation to propose three generation-related 64-dimensional fermion sets with identical Standard-Model gauge/spin charges, while allowing different u(1)_w choices and more complicated fermion/mirror mixing.

Exceptional Unification in L05 uses exceptional-Lie-algebra-valued superconnections with bosonic gauge 1-forms and Grassmann spinor fields, supercurvature containing curvature plus exterior-Dirac fermion derivative, and generalized-Hodge/Yang-Mills action architecture.

L05 treats e6/e7/e8 particle assignments as model-building proposals with distinct limitations: e6 is minimal/one-generation without spin, e7 has chirality/frame limitations, and e8 has Euclidean/grading/mirror-generation issues requiring further theory development.

L05 defines algebra automorphism groups by exact multiplication preservation, distinguishes Z2, SO(3), G2(-14) and split analogues, and gives explicit inner triality-related automorphisms whose validity differs between ordinary and split algebras.

L05's discussion explicitly presents triality/division algebra/Clifford/Lie/magic-square/eigenspace descriptions as mutually illuminating mathematical starting points while treating generation/Exceptional-Unification applications as model-building rather than established phenomenology.

L06 distinguishes a Lie group from its underlying torsor/group manifold, relates right group action to flow diffeomorphisms and generator vector fields, and uses the Maurer-Cartan form to map tangent vectors to Lie-algebra/model-tangent-space elements.

L06 defines the Maurer-Cartan equation, Killing form, Lie-group-manifold metric and invariant measure from structure constants/Maurer-Cartan components; the identity point is not geometrically distinguished after passing to the torsor.

L06 gives the conventional fiber-bundle/section/transition-function/principal-connection construction and distinguishes a connection on total space from its pullback gauge field on a base section; curvature is the failure of local pure-gauge Maurer-Cartan form.

L06 renders gravity with tetrad/cotetrad, Minkowski metric, Clifford model-tangent vectors, spin connection, torsion, Riemann curvature and spacetime Hodge duality as separate but related geometric structures.
